scientific_integrity: The proof rewrites each boundary as a weighted perspective of one strictly convex scalar function and applies Jensen's inequality, giving both the unique optimizer and exact minimum. The delayed-outcome coverage extension uses only the same fixed-level union bound as the source theorem. The asymptotic entropy penalty follows from a uniform finite-dimensional square-root expansion. The motivating full text and related confidence-sequence literature were inspected; targeted claim-level searches did not reveal the same allocation law, while a differently indexed convex-allocation antecedent remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The allocation must be fixed independently of the experiment; the result does not validate post-hoc allocation from random plug-in variance clocks. Exact convex optimality is stated for alpha<exp(-1/2), with a common mixture parameter eta. It optimizes the summed normal-mixture half-width at deterministic target clocks and does not jointly optimize eta or treatment assignment.
title: Exact square-root error budgeting for normal-mixture union confidence sequences
